title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
slides: OpenAI just launched Dots – what does it change?
Its bubbly agentic avatar feels human, not robotic.
But it can act autonomously, not just chat.
Thus, it can complete tasks without your constant input.
Try Dots for one daily workflow this week.
thread_text:
1. OpenAI's Dots: Human or Robot?

It looks like a bubbly avatar but acts like an autonomous agent. That shift changes how you delegate work.

2. Beyond Chat: It Acts

Dots doesn't just reply—it initiates tasks, makes decisions, and executes steps on its own.

3. No Babysitting Required

You can hand off a task and walk away. It completes the workflow without constant check-ins.

4. Your Time, Reclaimed

That means fewer interruptions and more focus on deep work. But you'll need to trust it.

5. Test It Today

Pick one daily workflow—like sorting emails—and let Dots run it. See if you'd keep it.
video_script: OpenAI just launched Dots, a new AI agent.
It looks like a friendly avatar, not a robot.
But it acts on its own, without needing your input.
So it can finish tasks while you do other things.
Try Dots on one daily workflow this week.

instagram.caption:
It looks like a friendly cartoon avatar, but it can finish a task without you watching.

OpenAI just launched Dots, an agent that chats and acts on its own. 🎈

It doesn't wait for your prompts: it starts tasks, makes calls, and executes steps by itself. 🤖

Hand something off, walk away, and it completes the workflow without check-ins. ⏳

So you can reclaim focus time, but you have to trust it with real work.

Which daily task would you hand off first — email sorting, scheduling, or something else? 📋
